name: slit guidance ligand 2
pathways: negative regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction

function.text: SLIT2 encodes slit homolog 2 protein [Cleaved into: Slit homolog 2 protein N-product; Slit homolog 2 protein C-product]. Annotated molecular activities include GTPase inhibitor activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in negative regulation of small GTPase mediated signal transduction and axon guidance.
